info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts equity reports - quant and enhanced quant API
equity reports - quant and enhanced quant

params.name: companyIdentifier
params.description: Unique identifier of a company. Valid values are performance ID or `exchange:ticker` value.

params.name: locale
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

items.docs: Get a Quantitative Report for the company specified in the `companyIdentifier` parameter. Quantitative Reports provide a detailed assessment of a company based on a quantitative analysis using a variety of company financial data and other data inputs. </br></br>You can identify a company using a performance ID (for example,`0P00012BBI`)  or `exchange:ticker` value, (for example, `XNAS:GOOG`). </br></br>To override the default value in the Accept-Language HTTP header, use the `locale` parameter.
